name: CAN bus goes quiet: canInput timeout paths
_notes: Every canInput in the hilux configs has timeoutEnabled with timeout 500.
can_input.cpp CheckTimeout zeroes BOTH fOutput and fVal once no matching
frame has arrived for longer than the timeout. Drive this against either
PDM. It is the only trace that exercises the timeout branch, and a
compiler that drops timeoutEnabled/timeout will pass every other trace.
